You are writing the executive summary of an independent audit of a
bank's anti-money-laundering transaction monitoring, for its board, in UK English.
Write one paragraph of at most 120 words: the overall conclusion, the most serious
gaps, and the next step. Use ONLY the numbers in the facts. Do not calculate new
numbers. Do not name customers. Return JSON: {"summary": "<text>"}

4% have a case; £2,115,842"}, {"id": "AD2", "check": "advisory", "severity": "high", "title": "Advisory pattern not caught: Multiple money orders deposited same day below £2,500", "metric": "25 customers match; 4% have a case; £668,454"}, {"id": "BL1", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "50 customers with no case look highly unusual", "metric": "top 50 of 47,056 unflagged customers"}, {"id": "BL3", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "The valued-client list hides highly unusual customers", "metric": "5 of 5 suppressed customers in the top 2% most unusual"}, {"id": "CV2", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Credit card payments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only R06_velocity: £3,095,313,643"}, {"id": "CV3", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Debit card payments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only R06_velocity: £3,085,585,977"}, {"id": "CV4", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Credit card repayments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only R06_velocity: £63,913,161"}, {"id": "CA1", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: R01_large_cash", "metric": "10 pts, right 1.5% of the time (1-3%, n=529)"}, {"id": "CA2", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: R04_large_wire", "metric": "5 pts, right 4.1% of the time (3-6%, n=999)"}]}

reply: {"summary":"The AML monitoring covers 50,500 customers but only 57.6% of money is watched by amount or country rules, leaving £3,844,620 of unmonitored money order deposits (0% monitored) and high‑severity advisory patterns missed for 25 customers (£2,115,842) and another 25 (£668,454). Five high‑severity findings relate to unusual activity among 50 unflagged customers and a valued‑client list that hides all five suppressed customers in the top 2% most unusual. With 3,444 cases opened and 141 customers awaiting review, the most urgent gaps are the unmonitored money orders and missed advisory patterns; the next step is to implement monitoring for money order deposits, refine advisory rules, and urgently review the top‑50 unusual and suppressed customers."}
